name: shariff-plus
description: Shariff-Plus enables website users to share or like their favorite content without compromising their privacy. It is based on Shariff by Heise Medien GmbH & Co. KG.

scripts.dev: npm run -s build && npm run -s copy_demo && ./node_modules/sass/sass.js demo/app.scss demo/app.css && npx http-server -p 3000 demo/
scripts.compile_less: ./node_modules/sass/sass.js --load-path=. src/style/shariff-complete.scss dist/shariff.complete.css && ./node_modules/sass/sass.js src/style/shariff.scss dist/shariff.min.css && ./node_modules/sass/sass.js src/style/dialogs/facebooklike_dlg.scss dist/facebooklike_dlg.css
scripts.copy_demo: rm -f demo/*.css && rm -f demo/*.js && rm -f demo/*.ttf && rm -f demo/*.woff2 && cp dist/*.* demo/
scripts.minify_css: lightningcss --minify dist/shariff.complete.css -o dist/shariff.complete.min.css && lightningcss --minify dist/shariff.min.css -o dist/shariff.min.min.css && lightningcss --minify dist/facebooklike_dlg.css -o dist/facebooklike_dlg.min.css
scripts.build: rm -fr dist && mkdir dist && npm run -s compile_less && npm run -s compile_js && npm run -s minify_css && npm run -s copy_fonts
